analysis.summary: Fictional sample: a short CPU peak coincided with background work. Disk usage reached 91% and returned to 68.5% after cleanup. The worker restarted once after an OOM exit. This text is authored for the demo; no model was called.

findings.title: Disk threshold crossed and recovered
findings.description: Usage exceeded the 90% threshold. Later samples were below the 80% recovery threshold.

findings.title: Worker restarted once
findings.description: The fictional worker exited with code 137 and then restarted.
